import numpy as np, itertools
fe={'1':np.ones_like(eps),'e':eps,'e2':eps**2,'sqe':np.sqrt(eps),'le':np.log(eps)}
fT={'1':np.ones_like(T),'T':T,'T2':T**2,'T3':T**3,'sT':np.sqrt(T),'lT':np.log(T),'1/T':1/T}
names=[];cols=[]
for a,b in itertools.product(fe,fT):
    names.append(a+'*'+b); cols.append(fe[a]*fT[b])
A=np.array(cols).T
c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,sigma,rcond=None)[0]
print('full', np.mean((A@c-sigma)**2)/np.var(sigma), A.shape)
# backward elimination
keep=list(range(A.shape[1]))
while len(keep)>1:
    errs=[]
    for k in keep:
        kk=[j for j in keep if j!=k]
        cc=np.linalg.lstsq(A[:,kk],sigma,rcond=None)[0]
        errs.append((np.mean((A[:,kk]@cc-sigma)**2)/np.var(sigma),k))
    e,k=min(errs)
    keep.remove(k)
    if e>1e-8: 
        print('stop at',len(keep)+1, e); break
print([names[j] for j in keep])
cc=np.linalg.lstsq(A[:,keep],sigma,rcond=None)[0]
print(np.mean((A[:,keep]@cc-sigma)**2)/np.var(sigma), np.round(cc,5))

    c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,sigma,rcond=None)[0]; return np.mean((X@c-sigma)**2)/np.var(sigma), c
